row_convention: Three ordinary five-bar fields and two heavy ones; unitary identity on ordinary SU(5) labels in the common GJ basis. Relative two-heavy-family identification allowed to be any U(2). No independent flavor transport of the high-scale Wilson coefficient; flavor-blind running absorbed in C_X. Matching ordinary weak and color flavor frames as in round 1744.
low_matching: Use the physical common color-threshold CKM row. The K phase is left free in universal bounds. Three active near-massless final species, a symmetric up-sector X vertex, canonical kinetic terms, no canceling BNV amplitude.
